entities.text: Collector/District Ram Sevak Sabha vs District Magistrate District Nainital
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Petitioner is further seeking writ of mandamus commanding the respondents not to obstruct the animal sacrifice in light of the permission granted on 30.8.2014 by the Medical Health Officer, Municipal Board, Nainital.
Undisputedly, Writ Petition (PIL) bearing Nos.73 of 2010 and 77 of 2010 were disposed of by the Division Bench of this Court vide judgment dated 19.12.2011.

The Division Bench of this Court vide judgment dated 19.12.2011, has held that 'the person sacrificing the animal can only sacrifice the same, not for the purpose of appeasing Gods, as he believes, but only for the purpose of arranging food for mankind.

The Division Bench was pleased to issue further directions to the State and its agencies to ensure that no destruction/killing/ sacrifice of any nature of any animal takes place outside a registered or licensed slaughter house, and to ensure that the purpose of such destruction/killing/ sacrifice is to arrange food for mankind and for no other purpose.

The crux of the judgment dated 19.12.2011 is that none can be permitted to sacrifice an animal for the purpose of appeasing gods, as he believes, but sacrifice is permitted only for the purpose of arranging food for the mankind and such sacrifice is to be done/made only in registered slaughter houses/licensed places.

Learned District Magistrate/Collector, Nainital, in the impugned order dated 1.9.2014, has held that as per the amended bye-laws of the Lake Development Authority, no temporary or permanent construction can be permitted within 30 meters radius of the Naini Lake or any other Lake within the jurisdiction of Lake Development Authority, therefore, establishment of temporary slaughter house on the bank of Naini Lake or near the Naina Devi Temple, is impermissible.
Feeling aggrieved, the present petition has been preferred.
It is true that vide order dated 30.8.2014, the Medical Health Officer, Municipal Board, Nainital, has permitted the Temple Committee to establish temporary slaughter house on the bank of Naini Lake.
Since, the judgment passed by the Division Bench of this Court on 19.12.2011 has not been challenged, therefore, the same has attained finality.

Thus, we are not going to touch the issue once again tried to be raised before us, as to whether, animal sacrifice, during Naina Devi Festival, is permissible under the Hindu custom and rituals or not.
We would like to remind observations of Division Bench of this Court in the judgment dated 19.12.2011 that no animal sacrifice is permitted to appeasing the Gods.
However, sacrifice/killing of animal is permitted for food to mankind that too, in Registered or licensed slaughter house/place.

We will confine ourselves to the issue as to whether any temporary or permanent slaughter house can be permitted to be raised near the Naina Devi Temple or in and around Naini Lake, in violation of building bye- laws of Lake Development Authority as well as in violation of Food Safety And Standards (Licensing And Registration)
Regulations, 2011.

Food Safety And Standards (Licensing And Registration)
Regulations, 2011
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Since, as per the existing building bye-laws, no construction is permitted within 30 meters radius of any Lake, we cannot permit either the district administration or the Municipality or the Lake Development Authority or the Naina Devi Temple Committee to construct/raise a temporary slaughter house near the Temple or, in and around the Naini Lake within the radius of 30 meters to Ram Sevak Sabha vs District Magistrate District Nainital ... on 2 September, 2015 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156267338/
2 sacrifice animals during Naina Devi Festival or other festivals.
Part-IV of the Food Safety And Standards (Licensing And Registration) Regulations, 2011 provides that 'No Objection Certificate' has to be obtained from the local authority before grant of licence for slaughtering any animal, whether sheep, goat or poultry birds.

entities.text: Ram Sevak Sabha vs District Magistrate District Nainital
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Food Safety And Standards (Licensing And Registration) Regulations, 2011
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
In the present case, no such 'Licence'
or 'No Objection Certificate' was ever obtained.

Thus, the argument advanced by Mr. Sharad Sharma, learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner, that during Naina Devi Festival, animals will be sacrificed for the purpose of consumption of devotees in the slaughter house in and around Naini Lake, does not hold water for want of 'No Objection Certificate' or 'Licence' under the Regulations of 2011.
In view of the discussion made hereinbefore, we are of the view that no interference is called for in the impugned order passed by the District Magistrate, Nainital.

Moreover, a writ of mandamus can be issued to enforce the pre-existing legal rights or to command the State or its instrumentalities to do something which law obliges them to do in accordance with law.

Since, Bye- laws of Lake Development Authority does not permit any type of construction within 30 meters radius of the lake and no permission has been granted under the Regulation of Food Safety and Standards Act

entities.text: Regulation of Food Safety and Standards Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
,
therefore, mandamus sought is not available to the petitioner.
With the result, the Writ Petition (PIL) No.133 of 2014 fails and it is hereby dismissed.
At the same time, in view of the reasons stated hereinbefore, the Writ Petition (M/S) No.1898 of 2012, also fails, hence is dismissed accordingly.
Let a copy of this judgment be also kept in Writ Petition (M/S) No.1898 of 2012.
